quarterly_data.quarter: Kanto Denka Kogyo TDnet: Revisions to Financial Results Forecasts (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Kanto Denka Kogyo revised the forecasts it announced on August 10, 2026. First half (April 1 - September 30, 2026) results: net sales JPY 44,400 million against a JPY 42,200 million forecast (+5.2%), operating profit JPY 9,400 million against JPY 6,600 million (+42.4%), ordinary profit JPY 9,500 million and profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 6,800 million (EPS JPY 118.56). Full-year forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 raised to net sales JPY 98,500 million (from JPY 95,000 million), operating profit JPY 14,600 million (from JPY 11,300 million), ordinary profit JPY 14,500 million and profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 9,900 million (EPS JPY 172.61). Reasons: specialty gas sales rose on growing semiconductor-industry demand, and profits benefited from passing higher raw material costs on to selling prices, cost reductions and consumption of inventory bought before raw material prices rose; the company assumes the raw-material timing benefit diminishes from the third quarter and expects demand to remain firm.
